scope: Ten authored miniature examples, not source corpus, model outputs, measured accuracy or an implemented semantic scorer. Never passed to runtime generator.
evaluation_unit: Expected labels describe focal propositions only. Whole-response rating requires inventory of all factual propositions and adjudication; these examples are not a complete scoring rubric.
label_policy: not_applicable excludes inapplicable metric; not_evaluable retains uncertainty. Partial/mixed labels require proposition/field breakdown before aggregation.
review_policy: Rate axes separately after adjudication; no automatic total usefulness score. Missing request when unwarranted is not a failure.

cases.context: Selected cell X1 states recorded voltage 20 V.
cases.rationale: A recorded value is not an independently verified physical measurement.

cases.context: Full frozen source X1 states 20 V; selected context lacks X1 and any voltage.
cases.rationale: Truth by reference does not supply missing runtime evidence.
Selected chunk membership and valid locator do not establish entailment.

cases.context: Selected X1 states 20 V. Report flags an unrelated missing material reference; no conflict affects X1.
cases.response: I cannot report voltage because validation failed.
cases.rationale: Report is advisory; inability assertion needs separate semantic inventory, not a safe label.

cases.context: Question asks voltage and current. Selected X1 states 20 V; current unavailable.
cases.response: Recorded voltage is 20 V [X1]. Current is absent from the selected evidence.
cases.rationale: Retain known field; absence claim is scoped to selected context, not all source.

cases.context: Selected context lacks current; full source has current elsewhere.
cases.response: The source contains no current value.
cases.rationale: Do not turn retrieval omission into source absence.

cases.context: Selected X1 states 20 V and report conforms. No external measurement is supplied.
cases.response: SHACL proves the actual physical voltage is 20 V.
cases.rationale: Conformance does not verify external physical truth.

cases.context: Selected X1 states 20 V, X2 states 30 V for the same record/time; neither has precedence.
cases.response: The two recorded voltage values conflict [X1, X2]. Please verify which source version applies before selecting one.
cases.rationale: Specific target/reason/evidence pointers support review usefulness; this is authored expectation, not measured usefulness.

cases.context: Selected X1 states 20 V. Answer asserts 30 V, then repeats perhaps 30 V.
cases.response: Voltage is 30 V. It may be 30 V.
cases.rationale: One normalized proposition, two spans; strongest certainty asserted.

cases.response: Voltage is 20 V [X1]. Voltage is 30 V [X1].
cases.rationale: Two conflicting propositions remain separate; correct occurrence cannot erase wrong occurrence.

limitations: No new task-specific numeric tolerances or real-data gold
No runtime repair or compulsory veto
